name: Negative closing-line value
action: LIVE -> PAPER immediately at window close
notes: CLV is the cleanest luck-resistant skill signal; a negative mean with n>=100 says the market beats the model.

name: Holdout ROI lower bound below zero
action: LIVE -> PAPER at the next settlement cycle
notes: The lower bound, not the point estimate, so a lucky run cannot hold the seat.

name: Drawdown beyond 3 sigma
trigger_statistic: peak-to-trough bankroll drawdown in sigma units
notes: Distinguishes a broken signal from ordinary variance.

name: Stale inputs
trigger_statistic: days since last verified input read at close
action: close snapshot invalid; strategy cannot take new live positions
notes: Freshness is itself a validation gate (VG-11); this rule demotes on breach.

name: Results-feed integrity failure
trigger_statistic: failed settlement audit against official results
action: LIVE -> PAPER until the feed is repaired and re-audited
notes: If settlement can be wrong, every downstream number is wrong.

name: Regime break without review
trigger_statistic: structural change (e.g., QB1 out long-term) without re-origination review
action: hold new live entries until re-origination review completes
notes: Example in this pack: BAL QB1 Jackson 6-10 week absence changes the rating regime (N6CF-R17).
